name: Ubisoft Entertainment SA
blurb: Ubisoft Entertainment SA is a French video game company that develops, publishes, and distributes games for consoles, PC, and mobile devices. Known for franchises such as Assassin's Creed, Far Cry, and Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six, it is one of the largest independent game publishers in the world. The company operates globally, with a focus on both physical and digital distribution.
recent: In the past 30 days, Ubisoft's stock has been volatile, trading near its 52-week low amid ongoing industry challenges. The company has faced delays in key titles and mixed financial results, with revenue declining year-over-year. Investors are watching for updates on upcoming releases and cost-cutting measures.
